In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], three [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] at a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] facility on [[Selvaris]] went by the nickname '''Clak'dor''' in reference to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. Many of the prisoners were referred to by such rather than their name. When [[Ryn one-one-five]], a member of the [[Ryn Network]], smuggled a secret message into the compound, all three Bith and the [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] [[Thorsh]] viewed and memorized the mathematical codes displayed by the [[holowafer]], and escaped the compound in order to bring the information to [[New Republic High Command/Legends|New Republic High Command]]. On a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike, this particular Bith was killed by Yuuzhan Vong [[lav peq]] while attempting to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
